SELECT dc.id AS commentId, 'destination' AS commentType, LEFT(dc.content, 200) AS contentPreview, dc.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN dc.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reply, dc.destination_id AS targetId, dt.name AS targetTitle, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS postType FROM destination_comments dc JOIN destinations d ON d.id = dc.destination_id JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' WHERE dc.user_id = #{userId} AND dc.deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT pc.id AS commentId, 'post' AS commentType, LEFT(pc.content, 200) AS contentPreview, pc.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN pc.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reply, pc.post_id AS targetId, p.title AS targetTitle, p.post_type AS postType FROM post_comments pc JOIN user_posts p ON p.id = pc.post_id WHERE pc.user_id = #{userId} AND pc.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT cc.id AS commentId, 'course' AS commentType, LEFT(cc.content, 200) AS contentPreview, cc.create_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN cc.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reply, cc.course_id AS targetId, c.title AS targetTitle, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS postType FROM course_comments cc JOIN courses c ON c.id = cc.course_id WHERE cc.user_id = #{userId} AND cc.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
